subject: Audit window coverage / interim mitigation plan request
messages:
From: Alyssa Martin <alyssa.martin@stellarchain.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Harris <mike.harris@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover audit window (post-report coverage)

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well. We’re in the final leg of our procurement review and the SOC 2 Type II Redwood provided ends 2023-04-30; the security team here flagged the gap between that report end and our contract start date.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short bridge letter or interim controls affirmation that covers the period from 2023-05-01 to today? Specifically StellarChain needs:
- explicit statement of no material changes to the control environment since the report period end, or a description of material changes and mitigation;
- confirmation of relevant attestations (incident response, access control, change management);
- a dated cover letter that we can attach to our security review pack.

I’ve looped in our auditor Mike in case you want to coordinate wording. If you can send a draft by early next week we’ll route it through legal and security here.

Thanks — small ask but high priority on our side.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Martin
Senior Procurement Manager | StellarChain
attachments: StellarChain_RFP_2027.pdf (ref)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Martin <alyssa.martin@stellarchain.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Harris <mike.harris@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover audit window (post-report coverage)

Alyssa — thanks for the clear note and for looping Mike. We can certainly help here. To make the bridge letter actionable for your security team we typically: 

1) Provide a short cover letter (1 page) stating the original SOC 2 Type II report period (ended 2023-04-30) and describing any material changes to controls since that date.
2) Attach an interim-controls summary (1–2 pages) listing major control areas (access, change mgmt, incident response) and a statement about their current status.
3) Provide a dated signature by an authorized Redwood control owner.

Quick Qs so we tailor it correctly:
- Do you need the letter to explicitly state an uninterrupted controls posture through 2027-06-01, or is a statement up to "current date" acceptable?
- Any particular language your security team prefers (e.g., "no material changes" vs "no material unremediated changes")?

I’ve attached a bridge letter template and the interim-controls summary we use for similar requests. Olga (Head of Security Compliance) — can you review the draft and confirm signatory and last internal review date? Laura — can you confirm whether legal needs a copy for signature routing?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: bridge_letter_draft_StellarChain.docx, interim-controls-summary.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Martin <alyssa.martin@stellarchain.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Harris <mike.harris@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover audit window (post-report coverage)

Hi all — I reviewed the requested wording and the initial draft. A few notes: 

- We can confirm that there have been no material unremediated changes to our control environment since the report period end. We will avoid absolute language ("no changes at all") and use "no material unremediated changes" which should pass typical vendor risk review.
- For the effective coverage date we can state "through 2027-06-01" to give a fixed endpoint for your reviewers.
- I’ve updated the interim-controls summary with: last internal controls review date (2027-04-15), change management process owner, and our most recent tabletop incident response exercise date. See attached interim-controls-summary.pdf.

We will sign the one-page bridge letter on Redwood letterhead. Laura — legal ok to route for signature and provide the authorized sig block? If legal needs a DocuSign envelope I can prep.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
attachments: interim-controls-summary.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Martin <alyssa.martin@stellarchain.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Harris <mike.harris@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover audit window (post-report coverage)

Alyssa — quick update: attached is the signed bridge letter and the interim controls summary. We used the wording "no material unremediated changes to the control environment since the report period ending 2023-04-30 through 2027-06-01."

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230430.pdf (for context), bridge_letter_draft_StellarChain.docx (final signed PDF), interim-controls-summary.pdf. I also uploaded the final signed PDF to a shared drive for your security team: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3bridge.

If StellarChain needs any minor edits to the language for your internal pack, let us know and we can coordinate with Mike for auditor-friendly phrasing. Otherwise please confirm receipt and that this satisfies the RFP ask.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20230430.pdf, bridge_letter_signed_StellarChain.pdf, interim-controls-summary.pdf
